project_name: PulseCRM - Modern Clinical & Practice Sales Management System
app_type: hybrid_fullstack (dense SaaS sales CRM & pipeline management)

design_philosophy.persona: E1: Top 1% Creative Designer. Precision architectural layout meets high-contrast tactile Swiss editorial ergonomics, tuned specifically for fast-paced junior reps and focused sales managers.
design_philosophy.theme: Light mode default with warm crisp slate-stone neutrals (#FAFAF9 / #FFFFFF) and deep ink navy (#0F172A) anchors, supplemented by calibrated status tokens and clean dark mode toggling.
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Intern-friendly, snappy, trustworthy, zero visual clutter, high information clarity, immediate task-to-action conversion.

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white
scale.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white
scale.overline: text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400

layout_and_navigation.structure: Sidebar + Sticky App Header + Responsive Sub-header with Global Search & User Switcher + Content Scroll Container

top_header.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 z-40 sticky top-0
features: Global quick search bar (Cmd+K) with instant modal drilldown
Role indicator & quick switcher (Manager vs Harry, Leo, Ben, Emma) for seamless testing & real multi-user simulation
Quick Action button: '+ New Lead' (opens modal with duplicate phone/email detection)
Notification bell with pending task count pill

kanban_board.style: Horizontal scrollable track with compact, rich prospect cards, stage counters, conversion value indicator, and column drop zones.
card_contents: Next follow-up date with urgency indicator (Overdue in red, Today in amber)
Last activity badge and lead response snippet

tabs: Activity Log & Timeline (Calls, WhatsApp, IG, Emails)
actions: Log Outreach (Call, WhatsApp, IG, Email) with quick-reply templates

filters: Task Type (Call, WhatsApp, Demo Prep, Proposal)
task_manager.quick_complete: Checkbox with micro-strikeout animation and immediate activity feed emission

team_performance_dashboard.philosophy: Collaborative Growth, No Toxic Leaderboard Ranking. Celebrates achievements and pipeline flow.

charts: Outreach activity breakdown by channel (Call, WhatsApp, IG, Email - Stacked Area / Bar)
Lead sources breakdown (Instagram, Referrals, Website, Cold Outreach, Clinic Directory - Donut Chart)

features: Manage Team Members (Harry, Leo, Ben, Emma, Admin/Manager)
Permissions matrix view (Demonstrates strict employee privacy where reps only view assigned prospects)
Data Export: Full Prospects CSV export with one-click trigger
Duplicate check sensitivity settings (Phone / Email / Clinic Name)

motion_and_micro_interactions.drawer_transition: framer-motion slide in from right with backdrop blur
motion_and_micro_interactions.badge_animations: soft pulse for 'Due Today' and 'Urgent Overdue' items

team_portraits.description: Diverse group of sales & customer success professionals for user avatars and team workspace banner

healthcare_clinic_scene.description: Modern medical and clinic reception setting representing target healthcare prospects

clinic_consultation.description: Clinic director consulting on digital solutions for demo cards and lead previews

testing_attributes_contract.rule: Every button, input, tab, nav-link, lead row, kanban card, metric card, and modal action MUST carry a distinctive 'data-testid' attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Strict permission enforcement: Harry, Leo, Ben, Emma must only view leads assigned to them under 'My Leads' and 'Dashboard', while Manager/Admin sees 'All Leads' and full team aggregates.

2. Include an intuitive Role Switcher in the top navigation bar so anyone evaluating the app can immediately toggle between Manager (Admin), Harry, Leo, Ben, and Emma to inspect permissions and tailored workspaces.
3. Implement the full 12-stage Kanban pipeline with drag and drop, quick move buttons, and column filters.
4. Add proactive duplicate detection on lead creation (warns immediately if phone or email already exists).

5. Populate realistic initial prospects with clinic/practice names (e.g., 'Aura Dental Clinic', 'Apex Physio & Wellness', 'St. Jude Dermatology', 'Harbor Health Partners') with rich multichannel activity histories.
6. Make sure Sonner toast notifications are used for actions like adding leads, moving stages, logging calls, and completing tasks.
7. Maintain crisp contrast with WCAG-compliant text colors, generous padding, and no transparent modal or dropdown backgrounds.
